visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Immutable Range with a shift Method
visualizerParams.problemDescription: A Range with public mutable fields is filled in by hand and shifted by copying the fields. Make it immutable: final fields, a constructor, a shift method that returns a new Range, and toString. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: Immutable objects can be shared freely, because nobody can change them behind your back. The shift method expresses the intent, and the original range is guaranteed to be unchanged.
